description: Christmas Island Utilities – Fuel Areas (Tanks) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development. Utilities data were supplied to Geoscience Australia by Gutteridge Haskins & Davey Pty Ltd (GHD) on 25th May 2001. Utilities data supplied included fuel related infrastructure. GHD compiled the utilities data from original CAD drawings collected over many years through management of island infrastructure by the Commonwealth Department of Administrative Services. Coverage: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development. Its tags are Christmas, IOT, fuel, infrastructure, pipelines. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
